title: diini ginok aqayyaare
intro: Hoxat tan agattinaan asta ruubeenih yenen. Ken raacat le manoh addat maabitina temeete—ken imaan ellecaboh aqayyaare takkem faxximtah tan assakat le gino luk. Ken gacsi ken sarrimaane amotani muhrisele. Atu ta maabitina xayyossem miyya kinnim kee tet cinteh tan maritteh maca tekkem baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Nanu duma nek dumî farmoytit miraacisak sugne marak sugne.
Qalek qalek kaxxa gino tewqe, ta agattiinah ni Rabbih asta.
Anu keenih excem: 'Ah Yallih gaali, tohih taagah Yallih ardik takmem tet cabaay, umaaneh tet maxagin.'
takkay immay ummatta yi gaali qanxisseh, sinni Rabbih amri sadak.
Anu dubuk ku Rabbih farmoyti kinniyo, nummat ruube—anu amaanat le nabiyyi kee taama abeena kinniyo.
zaalimih tu gactek, ni Rabbi cankaxi xongolot ken yoogoreeh, usun sinni buxaaxil angagoyya maleh yekken.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
